verdict.rationale: The SOS business portal lists a "Mass change registered agent" form, which implies a sanctioned registered-agent role that a provider can hold across many entities. That is only a single link label, with no description of how agents or other representatives are authorized to act for a company. Missing for 10: documentation of the registered-agent or authorized-filer role and its scope, any designee or representative authorization process, guidance on what a provider may file on the company's behalf, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
